product_backlog.description: Core infrastructure and foundational architecture setup for the To-Do List Web App.
List and task management capabilities including creation, viewing, task toggling, and deletion.
product_backlog.title: EP-0002: List and Task Management

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Allows users to organize tasks effectively.
product_backlog.title: Create a new to-do list
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks into separate categories.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the home page, When they enter a list name and click 'Create List', Then a new to-do list is created and displayed on the screen.
product_backlog.acceptance_check_note: Verified acceptance criteria: user can create a new to-do list via the web UI.

acceptance_criteria: Given an existing to-do list, When the user enters a short text description and clicks 'Add Task', Then the task is added to that list.
product_backlog.title: Add a task to a list
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can keep track of what needs to be done.

acceptance_criteria: Given a task exists in a list, When the user clicks the completion toggle, Then the task status updates between complete and incomplete, and is visually distinguished.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Provides immediate visual feedback on task completion status.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can track my progress.
product_backlog.title: Mark a task as complete or incomplete
Delete a task
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove unwanted items.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task exists in a list, When the user clicks the delete button on the task, Then the task is removed from the list.

product_backlog.title: Delete an entire list and its tasks
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Enables complete cleanup of major groupings.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing to-do list with or without tasks, When the user clicks the delete list button, Then the list and all its contained tasks are permanently removed.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can remove obsolete categories.

acceptance_criteria: Given multiple lists with tasks exist, When the user views the main application view, Then all lists and their corresponding tasks are displayed with completed tasks visually distinguished.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Provides transparency and readability for all user items.
product_backlog.title: View all lists and tasks with visual completion distinction
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to see all my lists and their tasks with completed items visually distinguished so that I have a clear overview of my work.

args: {"content": "import pytest
from app import app, lists, tasks

@pytest.fixture
def client():
    app.config['TESTING'] = True
    with app.test_client() as client:
        lists.clear()
        tasks.clear()
        yield client

def test_home_page(client):
    response = client.get('/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert b'To-Do List Web Application' in response.data

def test_create_list(client):
    response = client.post('/list/create', data={'name': 'Groceries'}, follow_redirects=True)
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert b'Groceries' in response.data
    assert 'Groceries' in lists

def test_add_and_toggle_task(client):
    client.post('/list/create', data={'name': 'Work'}, follow_redirects=True)
    client.post('/list/Work/task/add', data={'description': 'Finish report'}, follow_redirects=True)
    assert len(tasks['Work']) == 1
    assert tasks['Work'][0]['description'] == 'Finish report'
    assert not tasks['Work'][0]['completed']

    client.post('/list/Work/task/1/toggle', follow_redirects=True)
    assert tasks['Work'][0]['completed']

def test_delete_task(client):
    client.post('/list/create', data={'name': 'Work'}, follow_redirects=True)
    client.post('/list/Work/task/add', data={'description': 'Temp task'}, follow_redirects=True)
    assert len(tasks['Work']) == 1
    client.post('/list/Work/task/1/delete', follow_redirects=True)
    assert len(tasks['Work']) == 0

def test_delete_list(client):
    client.post('/list/create', data={'name': 'Obsolete'}, follow_redirects=True)
    assert 'Obsolete' in lists
    client.post('/list/Obsolete/delete', follow_redirects=True)
    assert 'Obsolete' not in lists
", "overwrite": true, "path": "tests/test_app.py"}
